title: Frustration behind the band's music and Bill's view
summary: They wanted emotional music and are looked on as ahead of their time.

story.theme_name: Playing with Coltrane and the avant-garde

blocks.x: Have you ever talked--I'm sure you talked with Bill somewhere at different points, about his feelings about the experience you had together.
What did he have to say?
Bill feels it probably more deeply than I do (inaudible).

As I think I mentioned before, Don Sebesky seems to think that you were ahead of your time as far as some of the concepts you introduced and the whole new dimension that you got, indirectly, in the studio recording.
We couldn't be, because they grew they grew up, really, out of frustration of that time, the things
that bugged Bill and bugged me that we didn't want to be involved in. We were forced to do these things.
You just didn't want to write for five saxes.
We wanted our music to say something that had an emotional spray, if you like--how do you describe it--there are no words to describe--you can say moved if you like.
